content: Human-labeling session — econ-contested-expansion:easy seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a contested-expansion mission. You hold a mini-base in the south-west corner — Construction Yard (fact), Power Plant (powr), Ore Refinery (proc), one harvester (harv, an unarmed ore-collector truck) on a small home patch, and two Light Tanks (1tnk) — with $2000 in the bank. A richer ore patch sits at the centre of the map inside a horizontal corridor framed by water walls — the only passable band between your lobe and the patch. Enemy rocket infantry already loiter on the patch. Within about 45 turns, finish with at least $6300 cash and own two Ore Refineries.
